text:
mira_sales: Quick sync  Prospect: MediCareAI wants a tightly-scoped EU-only POC. Requirements: inference and audit logs must stay in EU, BYOK, no non-EU subprocessors for this tenant, and failover limited to eu-central-1. They also want a short SOW snippet and cost estimate.
josh_se: Got it. Two clarifications before we promise anything: 1) Is 'no non-EU subprocessors' absolute or 'no processing outside EU (we can redact/report)'? 2) Do they accept control-plane signals that are anonymized?
eva_privsec: Customer language: "No processing outside EU for any customer data or logs. Control-plane telemetry may traverse global endpoints only if fully anonymized and no keys leave EU." They'll ask for a signed attestation and the subprocessor CSV. I'll prepare the draft.
nate_infra: Feasibility: We can pin tenant traffic to eu-west-1 GPUs and set a strict failover to eu-central-1. Default metrics pipeline forwards aggregated metrics to metrics-us; we can enable the EU-only metrics sink for this tenant if we flip a config flag. That needs a short change and a runbook.
mira_sales: Any impact to SLA or features when we mask telemetry and route metrics to EU sink?
josh_se: Feature impacts: 1) Reduced live debug traces (no payload traces), 2) Less granular sampling for latency heatmaps, 3) Some auto-rollbacks relying on detailed traces may be slower. Serving SLA unchanged. We should enumerate these in the SOW.
eva_privsec: BYOK: we support customer-managed KMS in eu-west-1 and KMIP/HSM for enterprise. We do not escrow plaintext keys. I will include KMIP steps in the BYOK checklist.
nate_infra: Operational notes: expected load for POC?
mira_sales: They said baseline 150 rps with short tails and occasional spikes to 400 rps for <10s. Median seq len ~128, 95th ~512 tokens. Also want egress estimate for eu-west-1 and an outline of reserved vs burst pricing.
nate_infra: Back-of-envelope: p95 target <=120ms implies we should cap batch wait to reduce tail latency and reserve ~3-4 GPUs to cover baseline+headroom (model-dependent). For spikes we can rely on burst pool but that will be billed separately. Egress: ~0.08 USD/GB in eu-west-1 (finance to confirm).
mira_sales: Can someone paste a concise routing directive JSON we can drop into the SOW? Needs to be simple for legal.
josh_se: Paste below:
```
X-Redwood-Residency: {"primary_region":"eu-west-1","failover":["eu-central-1"],"telemetry_mode":"eu-only","control_plane":"anonymized"}
```
eva_privsec: "Anonymized" = tenant_id and IPs hashed, no payload traces, no key material exported. Call out that this reduces debug fidelity and certain observability features.
deploy-bot: infra-ticket created: EU-METRICS-SINK-2101 assigned to nate_infra.
nate_infra: Ticket ETA: 2 business days for toggle + config rollout; capacity modelling: will attach GPU counts in 48h.
eva_privsec: I'll draft: 1) Subprocessor attestation (EU-only list + signed addendum), 2) BYOK checklist (KMS steps + KMIP note), 3) Telemetry commitment language. Expect drafts in 3 business days.
mira_sales: Great. Action items: Josh - draft SOW snippet (routing + feature impact). Nate - infra toggle + capacity numbers. Eva - attestation + BYOK checklist. I'll consolidate and send to MediCareAI. Thanks! :raised_hands:
